title: beads.nvim v1: browse and edit beads from Neovim
description: Neovim plugin to browse and edit bd (beads) issues, with a beads-workflow-aware layer (metadata badges, Workflow section, needs-me view). v1 launches no processes. Full agreed design is in the Design field; every child must follow it.
design:
# beads.nvim — agreed design

## Scope
- v1 = browse + edit `bd` issues from nvim. Designed so launching/watching agents can come later; v1 launches no processes.
- General `bd` UI plus a beads-workflow-aware layer (metadata badges, Workflow section, "needs me" view).
- Personal but publishable: Neovim >= 0.11; fzf-lua optional (fallback `vim.ui.select`); no hard deps besides `bd`.

## Data access
- Only via `bd ... --json`, async with `vim.system`. Always pass `-C <root>`. `bd list` always gets `-n 0` (default limit is 50).
- Root = `:pwd`, override with `:Beads cd <path>`.
- One adapter normalizes the two `dependencies` shapes:
  - `bd show --json`: `[{id, title, status, ..., dependency_type}]` (the related issues)
  - `bd list --json`: `[{issue_id, depends_on_id, type, ...}]` (the edges)
- `bd show --json` returns `metadata` as a structured object.

## Store + refresh
- One in-memory store per root, filled by `bd list --json --all -n 0`. Tree, badges, pickers read from it; subscribers are notified on refresh.
- Watcher: `uv.fs_event` on `.beads/`, reacting to `last-touched` and `embeddeddolt/<db>/.dolt/noms/manifest`; 200ms debounce; one store refresh. Writes made by the plugin are not double-refreshed.
- At start, `bd context --json`: if backend mode is not embedded, fall back to FocusGained/BufEnter refresh + one-time notice.

## Detail buffer `beads://<id>`
```
---
id: X-1            (read-only)
status: in_progress
priority: 1
type: task
assignee: momer
labels: [needs-review]
parent: X
blocked_by: [X-2, X-3]     (blocks-type deps only)
---
# <title>
## Description
## Design
## Acceptance
## Workflow      (read-only)
## Notes         (read-only)
## Comments      (read-only)
```
- Editable: frontmatter fields (except id), title, Description, Design, Acceptance. Edits to read-only regions are discarded on `:w` with a warning.
- `n` → float → `bd update --append-notes`. `c` → float → `bd comment`. Also `x` close (optional reason), `C` claim, `yy` yank id, `yr` yank run command.
- `:w`: parse → diff vs loaded snapshot → at most ONE `bd update` (text via `--body-file`/`--design-file`/`--acceptance`, labels via `--set-labels`, `--parent`) + ONE `bd batch` for `dep add/remove`. If the second fails, reload and report which part did not apply.
- Conflicts: remember `updated_at` at load; on `:w` re-fetch; if changed, refuse and offer reload / force / diff (split with current server version). External change on a modified buffer → virtual-text warning only, never silent reload.
- Create: `:Beads create` opens `beads://new` (defaults type task, priority 2); `:w` → single `bd create` (`--parent`, `-l`, `--deps blocks:<id>`, `--body-file`, `--design-file`, `--acceptance`, `-a`, `-t`, `-p`), then buffer renamed to `beads://<new-id>` and reloaded.
- Invariant: parse(render(bead)) produces an empty diff.

## Tree `:Beads tree`
- Left vsplit, width 50 (configurable), one per tabpage. Hierarchy = parent-child. `blocks` deps shown as inline markers (`⛔ blocked by X`). Closed hidden by default. Parentless beads at root.
- Keys: `<CR>` open detail in previous window, `a` add child (template with parent prefilled), `x` close, `C` claim, `R` refresh, `H` toggle closed, `za/zo/zc` fold, `yy` yank id, `yr` yank run cmd.

## Pickers
- `ready` (`bd ready`), `list` (open + in_progress), `search` (`bd search <q>`), `needs` (labels human/needs-review), `epics`.
- Lines: id, priority, status, title, workflow badges. Preview: rendered detail view.
- `<CR>` open, `ctrl-y` yank id, `ctrl-x` close, `yr` yank run cmd. fzf-lua adapter if present; else `vim.ui.select` (no preview).

## Workflow layer (beads-workflow 0.3.0 metadata)
- Badges: verdict + round (`✓` / `✗r2`), gate pass/fail, `👤` label `human`, `👀` label `needs-review`, `⏸` metadata `parked`.
- Detail Workflow section (read-only): verdict, review_round, findings, gate, tdd, bookmark, change, rounds, parked; for epics full_suite and full_suite_culprit.
- `yr` yanks `/beads-workflow:run-bead <id>`, or `/beads-workflow:run-epic <id>` for epics.

## Commands and keys
- One `:Beads <sub>` with completion: tree, ready, list, search, needs, epics, show <id>, create, cd <path>.
- No global keymaps. Buffer-local only, overridable via `setup({ keys = {...} })`. `g?` help float; maps carry `desc` so which-key shows them.
- `:checkhealth beads`: bd on PATH, bd version, `.beads` found for root, backend mode.

## Layout
```
plugin/beads.lua            -- :Beads command only, lazy
lua/beads/init.lua          -- setup(), config
lua/beads/cli.lua           -- async vim.system wrapper
lua/beads/model.lua         -- normalize shapes, workflow fields
lua/beads/workflow.lua      -- badges
lua/beads/store.lua         -- per-root cache, refresh, subscribers
lua/beads/watch.lua         -- fs_event, debounce, fallback
lua/beads/buffer/{render,parse,diff,write}.lua
lua/beads/views/{tree,picker,detail}.lua
lua/beads/pickers/{fzf,select}.lua
lua/beads/health.lua
```

## Testing
- plenary-busted in headless nvim. Unit tests on JSON fixtures captured from bd 1.2.2 (adapter, render, parse, diff). Integration tests run a real `bd init` in a temp dir.
acceptance_criteria:
- All child beads closed.
- :Beads tree, pickers, detail buffer edit/create, watcher, health all work against a real bd 1.2.2 embedded repo.
- make test passes headless.

title: Keymap overrides and g? help across views
description: Unify all buffer-local maps behind setup({ keys = {...} }): each action has a default key and desc; false disables it. g? opens a float listing active keys for the current view. Maps carry desc so which-key shows them. No global keymaps are ever set.
acceptance_criteria:
- Overriding a tree key in setup changes the mapping and g? output.
- Setting a key to false removes the mapping.
- No global (non-buffer-local) keymaps exist after loading and using the plugin.
- Every buffer-local map has a desc.

title: health.lua: :checkhealth beads
description: Report: bd on PATH, bd version (warn if older than 1.2.2), .beads found for current root (bd where), backend mode from bd context (warn that watching is disabled if not embedded), optional fzf-lua presence (info).
acceptance_criteria:
- :checkhealth beads shows ok for bd present, version, .beads found in a temp bd repo.
- In a dir without .beads it reports an error with a hint to run bd init.
- Missing bd reports an error and does not throw.

title: watch.lua: fs_event watcher with fallback
description: Watch the .beads/ directory with uv.fs_event, reacting to 'last-touched' and 'embeddeddolt/<db>/.dolt/noms/manifest'. Debounce 200ms and call store.refresh once. Suppress refreshes inside the store's self-write window. Start when the first beads view opens for a root, stop when the last closes. At start call 'bd context --json': if backend mode is not embedded, do not watch; instead refresh on FocusGained/BufEnter of beads buffers and show a one-time notice.
acceptance_criteria:
- Running 'bd update' from a shell causes exactly one store refresh within ~500ms while a tree is open (integration).
- Ten rapid writes produce one refresh (debounce).
- A write made through the plugin does not trigger a second watcher refresh.
- Closing the last beads view stops the watcher (handle closed).
- Non-embedded backend mode -> no fs_event, FocusGained refresh, single notice.

title: Pickers: ready, list, search, needs, epics
description: lua/beads/views/picker.lua with adapters lua/beads/pickers/fzf.lua (used when fzf-lua is installed) and select.lua (vim.ui.select fallback, no preview). Sources: ready (bd ready --json), list (open + in_progress from store), search (bd search <q> --json), needs (workflow.is_needs_me), epics (type epic). Line: id, priority, status, title, badges. fzf preview: rendered detail lines. Actions: <CR> open detail, ctrl-y yank id, ctrl-x close, yr yank run command (fzf: alt-r if yr is impractical; document it).
acceptance_criteria:
- Each source returns the expected beads from a fixture/temp repo.
- With fzf-lua absent, pickers use vim.ui.select and selecting opens the detail buffer.
- With fzf-lua present, preview shows the rendered bead.
- needs lists only beads labeled human or needs-review.
- Actions yank id / close / yank run command work.

title: Detail buffer: add note and comment floats
description: Buffer-local 'n' opens a small float; on confirm (<C-s> or :w in float) runs 'bd update <id> --append-notes <text>'; 'c' does the same with 'bd comment'. Both reload the detail buffer after success, preserving unsaved edits elsewhere is not required: if the detail buffer is modified, refuse with a message to :w first.
acceptance_criteria:
- n + text + confirm appends the note; Notes section shows it after reload (integration).
- c + text + confirm adds a comment visible in Comments.
- Empty text is a no-op with no bd call.
- On a modified detail buffer, n/c refuse with a message.
- Cancel (q/<Esc> in normal mode) closes the float without a bd call.

title: Tree view :Beads tree
description: lua/beads/views/tree.lua. Toggle a left vsplit (width from config, default 50), one per tabpage. Lines: indent by parent-child depth, id, priority, status, title, workflow badges, and '⛔ blocked by X' markers for open blockers. Closed beads hidden by default. Parentless beads at root. Re-renders on store notifications, keeping cursor on the same bead id. Keys: <CR> open detail in previous window, a add child (create_child), x close, C claim, R refresh, H toggle closed, za/zo/zc fold, yy yank id, yr yank run command, g? help.
acceptance_criteria:
- :Beads tree twice toggles the same window; a second tabpage gets its own tree.
- Epic with two children renders children indented under it; blockers shown as markers, not nesting.
- Closed beads hidden until H; H again hides them.
- After a store refresh the cursor stays on the same bead id.
- <CR> opens beads://<id> in the previous window, not the tree window.
- Badges from workflow.lua appear on lines.

title: Create flow: beads://new
description: ':Beads create' opens beads://new with the template (type task, priority 2). :w runs one 'bd create' with all set fields (text via files, --deps blocks:<id>, --parent, -l, -a), then renames the buffer to beads://<new-id> and reloads it. Expose create_child(parent_id) for the tree.
acceptance_criteria:
- :Beads create, fill title + description, :w -> bead exists with those values and buffer name is beads://<new-id> (integration).
- create_child(X) prefills parent: X and the created bead's parent is X.
- Empty title -> write refused with an error, no bd call.
- Exactly one bd process is spawned for a create.

title: Detail buffer: conflict detection and external-change warning
description: Remember updated_at at load. On :w re-fetch; if updated_at changed, refuse the write and offer reload / force / diff (diff opens a split with the current server rendering, diffthis on both). When the store reports the bead changed and the buffer is unmodified, reload silently; when modified, show a virtual-text warning line and never reload.
acceptance_criteria:
- Bead changed externally (bd update from shell) then :w on modified buffer -> write refused, choice prompt shown.
- Choosing reload discards edits and shows server version; force applies edits; diff opens split with server version.
- Unmodified buffer reloads automatically on store change; modified buffer gets a virtual-text warning and keeps edits.

title: diff.lua: snapshot vs parsed buffer -> bd operations
description: Compare loaded snapshot with parsed buffer and produce: (1) at most one 'bd update' arg list (--title, --status, --priority, --type, --assignee, --set-labels, --parent, description/design via files, --acceptance) containing only changed fields; (2) dep ops for blocked_by changes as bd batch lines 'dep add <id> <other> blocks' / 'dep remove <id> <other>'; (3) warnings for edits in read-only regions (id, Workflow, Notes, Comments), which are discarded. Also produce a 'bd create' arg list for new beads.
acceptance_criteria:
- Unchanged buffer -> no update, no dep ops, no warnings.
- Changing only priority -> update args contain only --priority.
- Adding and removing a blocked_by id -> one dep add and one dep remove line, no update.
- Removing all labels -> --set-labels with empty value (verify the actual bd flag behavior with an integration test).
- Editing Notes or Comments -> warning listing the region, no update for it.
- Changing id in frontmatter -> warning, ignored.
- New bead -> create args include -t, -p, --parent, -l, --deps blocks:<id> only when set.

title: Detail buffer beads://<id>: load and :w
description: lua/beads/views/detail.lua + buffer/write.lua. BufReadCmd beads://<id> fetches 'bd show --json', renders, sets filetype markdown, stores snapshot. BufWriteCmd: parse -> diff -> run at most one 'bd update' (text via temp files) then one 'bd batch' for deps; on success reload buffer and refresh store; if the batch fails after update succeeded, reload and report which part did not apply. Read-only regions highlighted (e.g. extmark/hl group). Buffer-local keys: x close (optional reason prompt), C claim, yy yank id, yr yank workflow run command, g? help. ':Beads show <id>' opens it.
acceptance_criteria:
- ':e beads://<id>' shows the rendered bead; modified flag is off after load.
- The detail load fetches comments: the bd show call used for beads://<id> passes --include-comments (via cli.show or an option on it), and a bead with a comment shows it in the Comments section (integration).
- Changing title and status then :w results in exactly one bd update call and bead reflects both changes (integration).
- Adding a blocked_by id then :w creates the blocks dependency (integration).
- Simulated batch failure after successful update reloads buffer and notifies which part failed.
- Edits in Notes are reverted on :w with a warning.
- x, C, yy, yr work and are listed by g?.
notes: Owner approved: detail load must pass --include-comments to bd show (plain bd show --json omits comments; found while writing tests for ge7.3).

title: buffer render + parse with round-trip invariant
description: lua/beads/buffer/render.lua: Bead -> lines in the agreed layout (YAML-style frontmatter: id, status, priority, type, assignee, labels, parent, blocked_by; '# <title>'; sections ## Description, ## Design, ## Acceptance, ## Workflow, ## Notes, ## Comments). Also returns region metadata marking read-only regions (id line, Workflow, Notes, Comments). lua/beads/buffer/parse.lua: lines -> editable fields table. Template render for a new bead (no id, type task, priority 2, optional parent). Must handle multi-line text, empty sections, '##' inside fenced code in descriptions, and lists in frontmatter.
acceptance_criteria:
- For every fixture bead, parse(render(bead)) equals the bead's editable fields (round-trip).
- Text containing '## ' inside a fenced code block in Description survives round-trip.
- Empty Description/Design/Acceptance round-trip as empty, not nil-vs-'' mismatch.
- Workflow section lists the workflow.lua fields; Comments show author, time, body.
- Read-only region metadata covers id, Workflow, Notes, Comments exactly.
- Template render for new bead with parent prefilled parses back to type task, priority 2, that parent.

title: workflow.lua: beads-workflow badges and fields
description: Given a normalized Bead, compute badges and a Workflow field list per beads-workflow 0.3.0 metadata. Badges: verdict CLEAN -> '✓', ISSUES -> '✗' with 'r<review_round>' suffix when present; gate pass/fail; label human -> '👤'; label needs-review -> '👀'; metadata parked present -> '⏸'. Workflow fields (ordered, for the detail section): verdict, review_round, findings, gate, tdd, bookmark, change, rounds, parked; for epics also full_suite, full_suite_culprit. Badge glyphs configurable via setup(). Also run_command(bead) -> '/beads-workflow:run-bead <id>' or '/beads-workflow:run-epic <id>' for epics. Also is_needs_me(bead): label human or needs-review.
acceptance_criteria:
- A bead with verdict=ISSUES, review_round=2 renders badge '✗r2'; verdict=CLEAN renders '✓'.
- Bead with no workflow metadata/labels has empty badges and an empty Workflow field list.
- Epic beads include full_suite fields when set; tasks never do.
- run_command returns run-epic for type epic and run-bead otherwise.
- is_needs_me true for labels human or needs-review, false otherwise.
- Overriding a glyph via setup() changes the badge output.

metadata.findings: nit lua/beads/workflow.lua:52 - question: a JSON-null metadata value (vim.NIL, not stripped by model.tbl) counts as set, so parked=null shows the parked badge and fields() lists it; treat vim.NIL as unset?

title: store.lua: per-root cache with refresh and subscribers
description: One in-memory store per root, filled by cli.list({all=true}) and normalized via model. API: get(root), refresh(root, cb), subscribe(root, fn) -> unsubscribe, by_id, children_of(id), roots() (parentless). Concurrent refresh requests coalesce into one in-flight bd call plus at most one trailing call. Provide a 'self-write' marker so a refresh already triggered by a plugin write can suppress the next watcher-triggered refresh within a short window.
acceptance_criteria:
- Two refresh() calls while one is in flight produce at most two bd list invocations total.
- Subscribers are notified once per completed refresh with the new state; unsubscribe stops notifications.
- children_of and roots reflect parent-child links; closed beads are included (filtering is a view concern).
- A failed refresh keeps the previous data and reports the error to subscribers.
- Stores for two different roots are independent.

title: model.lua: normalize bd JSON into one bead model
description: Normalize both 'bd show --json' and 'bd list --json' output into one Bead table: id, title, status, priority, type (from issue_type), assignee, labels, parent, description, design, acceptance (acceptance_criteria), notes, comments, metadata, updated_at, blocked_by (blocks-type deps only, list of ids), children ids when derivable. show deps shape: [{id, dependency_type,...}]; list deps shape: [{issue_id, depends_on_id, type,...}]. Capture real fixtures from bd 1.2.2 into tests/fixtures/ (show of a bead with parent+blocks deps+labels+metadata+comments; list of several beads incl. closed and epic).
acceptance_criteria:
- Fixtures in tests/fixtures/ are real bd 1.2.2 output (show and list).
- Normalizing show and list output of the same bead yields equal parent and blocked_by.
- parent-child deps never appear in blocked_by; blocks deps always do.
- Missing optional fields become nil/empty tables, never errors.
- metadata numbers and strings are preserved (review_round stays a number).

title: cli.lua: async bd runner
description: lua/beads/cli.lua wraps vim.system. Every call passes '-C <root>' and '--json' where applicable; root defaults to vim.fn.getcwd() and can be overridden by ':Beads cd <path>' (state kept per tabpage-agnostic global). Helpers: list({all=bool}) always adds '-n 0'; show(id); ready(); search(q); context(). Callbacks run on the main loop (vim.schedule). Errors: bd not on PATH, non-zero exit (include stderr tail), invalid JSON — all returned as structured errors, never thrown. Also a run_with_files helper that writes text args to temp files and deletes them after.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every invocation includes '-C <root>'; list always includes '-n 0', and '--all' when requested.
- Non-zero exit returns {err=..., stderr=...} with the stderr tail; callback is called exactly once.
- Missing bd binary returns an error mentioning 'bd not found'.
- Invalid JSON returns a decode error, not a Lua error.
- ':Beads cd <path>' changes the root used by subsequent calls.
- Temp files from run_with_files are removed after the process exits, including on failure.
- Integration test: list() against a temp bd repo with 55 issues returns all 55.

title: Scaffold plugin, config, :Beads command and test harness
description:
Create the plugin skeleton: plugin/beads.lua (defines :Beads only, lazy-requires modules), lua/beads/init.lua (setup() merging user config over defaults: tree width 50, keys table, fzf auto-detect), and a :Beads <sub> dispatcher with completion for: tree, ready, list, search, needs, epics, show, create, cd. Unimplemented subcommands notify 'not implemented yet'.
Test harness: plenary-busted in headless nvim via 'make test' (tests/minimal_init.lua bootstraps plenary from a local or cloned path). Provide tests/helpers with (a) loading JSON fixtures from tests/fixtures/ and (b) creating a temp dir with a real 'bd init' for integration tests (skip cleanly if bd is missing).
Add a '## Quality gates' section to CLAUDE.md with a row for all areas: 'make test'. Fill in the Build & Test section.
acceptance_criteria:
- 'make test' runs plenary-busted headless and exits 0 with at least one passing test.
- :Beads with no args or unknown sub shows usage; completion lists all subcommands.
- require('beads').setup({keys={...}, tree={width=60}}) deep-merges over defaults; setup() with no args works.
- Loading the plugin does not require any lua/beads/* module other than via :Beads (verified by package.loaded check).
- Integration helper creates a temp bd repo and removes it after the test.
- CLAUDE.md has a '## Quality gates' table with gate command 'make test'.
